reviews.text: We’ve been working with Diana since we got our puppy at 10 weeks. From the intro call, you can tell she is so passionate and caring about giving each dog a good balance of structure to learn and grow all in a manner that’s emotionally considerate. Her training sessions are interesting, tailored to your dog and also you as a dog parent. We saw immediate benefit after each session with Diana. She has set us up with great tools to keep building on commands in a way that suites our little girl best, and starting to learn some fun tricks! We bought the six pack of sessions and have learned so much through her. We’ll definitely be doing some further in the future with her! Her communication and availability to speak to her clients is so impressive. As a young puppy mom we had a few moments we were nervous about and Diana chatted us through it all calmly and helped us decided what actually needed to get checked out vs what was standard puppy behavior. Highly recommend!

Just had second session with my two dogs. One is a recent arrival  ,a bulldog ,and the other is a 10 year old Jack Russell that I have had from 9 weeks. Quite a combination . Diana has been friendly , professional and has achieved behaviour modification already. I will  do my homework and we will all see her again soon. Glad I found her.

Diana is absolutely fantastic. She is one of the most caring, attentive, and detail-oriented professionals I’ve ever worked with. From the very beginning, she truly listened - not just to what was happening with my dog, but to me as well. She takes the time to observe, assess, and thoughtfully choose the right approach for both the dog and the guardian. It never feels like a one-size-fits-all method.

What I really appreciate is that the work feels mutual. It’s a collaboration. Diana explains everything clearly, communicates in a way that makes sense, and makes sure you understand the “why” behind what you’re doing. She’s incredibly patient - with dogs and with owners 😉 - and creates a space where you feel supported rather than judged.

She’s also constantly learning, researching, and striving to grow. You can tell she thinks outside the box and looks for solutions that genuinely fit the individual dog in front of her. You won’t hear the typical “we’ll fix this in a few sessions” promises. She understands that every dog is different, every journey is different, and she’s honest about the process.

If you’re looking for someone knowledgeable, compassionate, and truly invested in helping both you and your dog succeed, I highly recommend Diana.

We brought in Diana when our GSD, Rex, was just 2 months old and signed up for the 10‑session package – and we’re so glad we did. Rex now reliably responds to cues like sit, recall, wait and leave it, and the progress has honestly been incredible. Diana clearly has a deep understanding of dog behaviour and psychology, and she explains everything in a way that’s easy for us to follow at home. I would highly recommend Diana to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, patient and effective dog trainer.

I do not usually write reviews, but I felt compelled to share my experience.

During the initial consultation, Diana came across as eager and professional. However, things changed quickly after the first session. While parts of the session were fine, I experienced several moments that felt rude and awkward. She openly stated she was less interested in working with me because my dog was “less of a challenge” than she had hoped for, which I found unprofessional and discouraging.

I also felt uncomfortable when I was repeatedly encouraged to allow my dog to be featured on her social media, which seemed more focused on promoting her brand than supporting my needs as a client.

After the session, my dog’s behaviour did not improve and in fact worsened. The follow-up materials provided were generic PDFs that did not feel tailored to my dog or situation.

Communication became a major issue. A message I sent went unanswered for over a month, despite showing as read. When she eventually responded, she was dismissive and critical of me for using text messaging — even though text had previously been used as a normal method of communication that she had initiated. I did not receive any further response after that message.

I was also uncomfortable with the pricing structure. The full quote was only provided after the consultation and first session, and I was asked to commit to a significant upfront payment in order to secure a lower per-session rate. Session length and scheduling were not explained, which made it difficult to feel confident about what I would actually be receiving. It was over £100 for each session or £50 for each session IF you paid almost £1000 upfront. There was no flexibility or communication. Urgency and desperation tactics were used.

Overall, I found the experience inflexible, impersonal, and lacking transparency. Based on my experience, I would not recommend this service. I think a professional organisation with a training centre would be a better use of funds and more effective.

For those working on dog reactivity, I have personally found more progress by focusing on consistent daily training: staying calm, rewarding good behaviour, reinforcing obedience basics, engaging my dog with enrichment activities, and gradually working around triggers over time. In my experience, meaningful behavioural change takes patience and ongoing work.

We first contacted Diana about a month before we even brought our little staffy, Nala, home. As first-time dog owners, we knew we wanted to do things properly from day one, so we were looking not just for a trainer, but for a behaviourist who could walk us through the deeper “why” behind everything and help us prepare in the best possible way.

Nala joined us at 6 months old, and she had been severely under-socialised. Those first days were honestly quite overwhelming – she was too scared to even step outside our front door, and we really weren’t sure if we were going to be able to handle it. That’s where Diana made all the difference. She was always calm, reassuring and incredibly supportive, reminding us that progress takes time and that everything would be okay with patience and consistency.

One thing that truly stood out was how available she was for us, even outside of our scheduled sessions. There were moments where we felt stuck or worried, and even when she was on holiday, she still found the time to guide us and help us through it. That level of care and commitment meant the world to us, especially in those early, anxious weeks.

Now, four months in, we honestly can’t believe how far Nala has come. She’s gone from being unable to step outside our home to enjoying long walks, playing happily in the park with other dogs, and confidently navigating many vet visits and tube rides. Even when we were impatient or doubting ourselves, Diana stayed steady, kind and solution-focused, always bringing us back to the bigger picture and the progress we had made.

Diana is incredibly knowledgeable and experienced, but what makes her special is how clearly she explains everything. She doesn’t just tell you what to do – she helps you understand your dog’s emotions and behaviour, and shows you step by step how to support them in a way that is fair, kind and effective. We always finish our sessions feeling more confident, more informed and more connected to Nala.

We couldn’t have wished for a better trainer and behaviourist to guide us and Nala on this journey. We are so grateful for everything she has done for our little family and would recommend her wholeheartedly to anyone looking for real, thoughtful support with their dog.

Diana is an incredibly attuned and caring trainer and behaviourist who's been working with me and my puppy Bronte since I first brought home. She's very very knowledgeable and has been so helpful in helping Bronte settle. Thank you!

Diana is an amazing dog trainer — professional, patient and truly dedicated.
She always explains things clearly and gets straight to the point, which makes every session super effective.
We saw real progress with our dog, and she helped us solve problems we’d been struggling with for months.
Highly recommended!

Diana helped our dachshund Mia become more confident outdoors and improve with potty training, using a kind, force-free approach. She’s patient, creative, truly loves dogs, and always supports us as owners. Mia adores her and the classes have been great for her wellbeing. We’re happy to keep working with Diana and gladly recommend her to anyone looking for a thoughtful, compassionate trainer.

I could not recommend Diana enough, amazing knowledge about dogs it's like nothing I've seen in other dog trainers. She has a more positive way of handling dogs, I have 2 Chow Chows and she has helped me eliminate all their bad traits and now we have 2 loving, affectionate  calm Chows thank you so much.

My dog is 12 years old, and she lived her whole life in a village without any training. I always thought I had to scold her for her to understand what not to do. After moving to London, the need for training became clear. My dog was aggressive towards other animals on the street, making walks and going to crowded places impossible, and her "give" command was frustrating. In spring 2024, we contacted Diana, took four lessons, and then practiced at home under Diana's supervision. In six months, the dog changed beyond recognition.
* We re-established contact and a trusting relationship with the dog; we no longer scold her, but only encourage her.
* The dog no longer lunges at other dogs; her owner is now the priority, not other animals or distractions.
* The dog has become manageable, and we continue to improve her skills.
And all of this at 12 years old! Our wild spaniel, a hunting breed, has blended into the rhythm of London ❤️ Thank you, Diana, for your productive work!

Diana is just great! Extremely calm, professional and competent. Very easy to communicate to, always on time and overall so understanding and pleasant! She has two well-behaved rescue dogs of different sizes, so apart from usual training, she can also help with your dog’s destructive behavior towards or in presence of other dogs.

In my case she helped me to deal with my dog’s resource guarding and overprotection of me from other dogs (on video my dog is on the left and at this stage of training she allows me to share her treats and pet Diana’s dog on the right which is a huge progress compared to not even allowing other dogs to be close to me).

Thank you very much, Diana! I know this review is long overdue, but it is better late than never 🙈🙂

Diana has been amazing working with our very energetic Vizsla since the age of about 6 months. The changes are all positive and very noticeable. She is incredibly knowledgeable, caring and is considerate of both our and our dog’s needs. A fantastic trainer/behaviourist, I can’t recommend her highly enough 5 stars.

Diana is an incredible dog trainer and behaviourist. We have been working with Diana to ensure we get everything right with our new puppy. The knowledge, passion and understanding Diana has are nothing short of incredible. Diana has an explanation and understanding to everything, no matter how simple or complicated, which really helps in understanding your own dog and makes training so much easier, because you actually understand why you are doing what you are doing. Diana is also a lovely and pleasant individual who really cares for you and your dog. Strongly recommended and would absolutely use Diana again. Thank you Diana!

Diana is an absolute dog whisperer! Not only she easily finds a key to a dog but also teaches dog owners in a lightweight manner and checks they’ve understood the plan and next steps correctly 👍
We had 6 sessions and our previously reactive to motorcycles dog was able to lay on the corner of a busy street and relax watching motorcycles passing by - we would never think it is possible.
What was also important for us is that Diana only uses cruelty-free approaches and always has plenty of treats to really encourage any dog 🐶
Highly recommend sessions with Diana especially to reactive dog / first time dog owners!
